title: The Last Oath Anew
author: Dominic Nystrom
blurb: Xanthe Voss, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
